name: NAPPY HAIR PLANET
niche: hair salon boutique (natural hair, locs, braids)

address.notes: Confirmed current address via BOTH live booking platforms (Booksy JSON-LD and Fresha JSON-LD, same street address, scraped same session). Booksy's own JSON-LD has a zip typo (32304); Fresha and an independent LoopNet listing for the same street address confirm 32308, used here. A 2026-07 Booksy review ('New location was welcoming & easy to get to') confirms the business relocated at some point. The business's Florida LLC filing on Sunbiz/bizprofile still lists the OLD principal address, 1732 Thomasville Rd, Tallahassee, FL 32303 (the address given in the initial task brief) — that appears to be a stale filing address, not the current operating location. Both live booking platforms agree on 1373 E Tennessee St, so that is used as the real, current address on the site.

reviews_count_source: Booksy JSON-LD (581816_nappy-hair-planet_braids-locs), scraped live via booksy_dossier.py. A separate/older Booksy listing id (573282) surfaced in search with 84 reviews; treated as a stale duplicate, not used.
hours_note: Booksy's own JSON-LD (the business's real booking calendar) lists specific, limited appointment windows Tue/Wed/Fri/Sat only, typical of a single-stylist studio. Fresha separately lists generic 'Mon-Fri 9-7, Sat 9-5, Sun closed' storefront hours, which looks like an unedited platform default rather than Aisha's real appointment availability. Booksy's specific per-day windows were used on the site as the more trustworthy source (same reasoning as the true-glow-esthetics-hollywood precedent).
phone_source: Fresha JSON-LD (fresha.com/lvp/nappy-hair-planet-thomasville-road-tallahassee-7xRX5z), scraped live: telephone field tied to the exact current address (1373 E Tennessee St). Booksy's own page publishes NO phone number at all (common Booksy behavior, forces booking through the app). The number '850-445-0474' mentioned in the initial task brief and repeated in several AI web-search summaries could NOT be independently verified against any live, direct source (not on Booksy, not on Fresha, no working reverse-lookup match) and may be a stale number tied to the old Thomasville Rd location; NOT used on the site to avoid publishing an unverified contact.

Sunbiz / bizprofile.net LLC filing (Nappy Hair Planet, LLC, registered agent Aisha E. Reeves): no email listed in the public filing summary.

Conclusion: no public email found after exhausting all listed sources. Outreach will rely on Instagram DM and/or phone (call/text) as the manual channel.

photos.curation_notes: All photos were opened and visually inspected one by one (contact sheets + individual reads) before selection, per the mandatory visual curation step. Discarded: 1 extreme scalp/part close-up (too clinical/anatomical for a public gallery), 1 duplicate of the silk-press photo with a red 'SILK PRESS' caption burned into the image (used the clean duplicate without on-image text instead), 4-5 near-duplicate crops of the same customer's gray twists from review photos (kept only the single best crop), 1 unrelated review photo (a customer at a Lion King theater poster, not a hair result), and the staff photo of Aisha Reeves (used only as a small avatar candidate for the About section per the pipeline rule against stylist portraits in the gallery, not used as a gallery tile in the final build). The staff photo is 918x918, plenty sharp; not used in the final gallery grid to keep the guideline strict, but kept in assets/raw for potential 'meet Aisha' use.

brand_vibe: Bold, warm, Afrocentric pop identity: black-background logo in yellow/green/red with a globe and 'One Love' heart mark. Real interior/result photos lean warm and rich: black styling chairs with gold-trimmed capes, deep brown and reddish-brown loc tones, magenta/pink towels and chair linings, warm golden studio light. Built on the dark template with a warm black background and a terracotta-gold accent (distinct hex from other locs-niche builds) rather than the literal red/yellow/green of the logo, which would read as unprofessional at full saturation on a premium site.
